places.name: Hat Creek herd camp west of Austin
places.note: Country opens into better grass; the cookless crew grumbles over Augustus's scrambled eggs while Call rides off alone each night.
places.location_hint: on the trail north of San Antonio after two weeks of mesquite, about twenty miles west of Austin

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Beyond it the brush finally thins out for the herd.

places.name: Clara's orchard
places.note: Augustus detours to a live-oak grove by a spring-fed pool where he and Clara picnicked, and weeps remembering her refusal of his proposal.
places.location_hint: small spring-fed creek feeding the Guadalupe, live oaks on a sizable hill, just north of the wagon road from the herd into Austin, west of Austin

places.name: Guadalupe River
places.note: The little creek at Clara's orchard drains into it.

places.raw_name: a little camp at the foot of a limestone bluff
places.name: Lorena's camp by the limestone bluff
places.note: Bruised Lorena waits alone by a pool; Jake left in anger two days ago, so Augustus stays to keep her company.
places.location_hint: about three miles beyond Clara's orchard toward Austin, by a pool and trees at the foot of a limestone bluff, west of Austin

places.name: Austin
places.note: Call rides on alone to hire a cook and buy horsehair reins; Jake has evidently gone there to gamble.

places.name: High Plains
places.note: As Rangers there, Augustus's keen eyes told sage bushes from Indians in the mirages.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Another Ranger haunt where Augustus's eyesight proved itself.
places.location_hint: country along the Pecos River, west Texas

places.name: Kentucky
places.note: Home of the horse trader Clara married instead of Augustus.

places.name: Texas
places.note: The herd grazes so slowly Newt fears they will never get out of it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: The far destination that seems endless to Newt.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Call tells the bucking mare he means to ride her across it.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp west of Austin
groups.hint: herd grazing north about twenty miles west of Austin

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.at: Lorena's camp by the limestone bluff
groups.hint: west of Austin, three miles from Clara's orchard

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: riding the Hell Bitch toward Austin to find a cook, not yet arrived
